h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Assam

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Assam

items.pText: Assam gets more rain than most of India, and a playground here has to cope with wet ground for months at a stretch. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, housing societies, parks, tea estates and institutions across the state. Our factory is in Vasai East, Maharashtra, and we send equipment to Assam by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

Guwahati has most of the state's apartment projects and large private schools. Towns in Upper Assam, such as Jorhat, Dibrugarh and Tinsukia, have schools, clubs and estate colonies of their own, and the Barak Valley around Silchar is a separate market again. Each area has its own mix of buyers. Wherever your site is, we start from its size, the age group of the children and a few photos, then send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Planning for the Brahmaputra valley's rain

c: The monsoon in Assam starts early and runs long, and low-lying areas flood in most years. Raise the play area above the surrounding ground and give it a drainage slope, so water runs off instead of pooling under the equipment. Rubber flooring on that raised base dries faster than soil and cushions falls, and we supply it with the equipment.

Humidity also brings moss and algae on shaded surfaces. Scrub decks and steps from time to time so they do not turn slippery. Roto-moulded plastic does not rust, and galvanised steel posts are protected by their zinc coating, which is why we use both throughout our ranges.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you install playground equipment across Assam?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment by road from our Vasai factory to Guwahati and other towns in the state, and install it through our own team or a dealer, grouted or self-standing.

items.q: What surface works best under play equipment in a flood-prone area?
items.a: Rubber flooring on a raised, well-drained base. It cushions falls, dries faster than soil after rain and keeps children off mud. We can supply it along with the equipment.

items.q: Can you plan a playground for a tea estate school?
items.a: Yes. Share the size of the ground, the age groups and photos. We will suggest pieces that suit a large group of children and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

items.q: What warranty do you give on playground equipment?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as per our instructions.
